verdict.rationale: Wrike ships its own AI agents and Copilot, so acting as an MCP client is a fair question for this product. The only MCP evidence (wrike-docs-1) covers the opposite role: exposing Wrike to external assistants like Claude and ChatGPT as an MCP server. Nothing shows Wrike's agents or Copilot can connect to third-party MCP servers and use their tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
